collocation: spend + 時間/金錢 + on N / V-ing
example: Tom spent two hours doing his English homework yesterday.
tip: 主詞必須是「人」！後面接動詞務必加 -ing，不可接 to V。

example: The brand new bicycle cost him three thousand dollars.
tip: 主詞必須是「物」或「IT」！過去式與過去分詞同形 (cost-cost-cost)。

collocation: It takes + (人) + 時間 + to V
example: It took me forty minutes to walk to the train station.
tip: 花費時間常用虛主詞 It 開頭，後面動詞必須用 to 原形動詞。

collocation: pay + 金錢 + for + 物品
example: My father paid five hundred dollars for the delicious meal.
tip: 人當主詞，付錢買某物介系詞用 for；付錢給某人用 pay someone。

collocation: can / can't afford + to V / N
example: As a student, I cannot afford to buy an expensive smartphone.
tip: 常與 can/could 助動詞連用，後接不定詞 to V。

example: May I borrow your English dictionary from you?
tip: 易混淆詞！borrow 是「借進來」，lend 是「借出去 (lend to)」。

collocation: lend + 物 + to 人 / lend 人 + 物
example: Could you lend me some money to buy the notebook?
tip: 三態為 lend-lent-lent，出題委員最愛考 borrow/lend 互相改寫。

collocation: prefer A to B (喜歡 A 勝過 B)
example: I prefer reading novels at home to going to the noisy party.
tip: 注意！介系詞用 to（非 than），且 A 與 B 結構必須平行（如皆為 V-ing）。

example: The little boy refused to eat any green vegetables.
tip: 後面一律接不定詞 to V，反義詞為 accept。

collocation: decide + to V / make a decision
example: They decided to travel to Hualien during the summer vacation.
tip: 改寫時常與 make up one's mind (下定決心) 互相代換。

example: Our English teacher expects us to practice speaking every day.
tip: 主動語態 expect someone to V；被動語態 be expected to V。

collocation: promise + to V / keep a promise
example: Lisa promised her parents to study hard for the coming exam.
tip: 寫作搭配詞：keep a promise (信守承諾) vs. break a promise (違背承諾)。

collocation: remind + 人 + of + 事物 / to V
example: This sweet song reminds me of my happy childhood.
tip: 「使某人想起某事」用 remind someone of something。

collocation: suggest + V-ing / that + S + (should) + 原形動詞
example: The doctor suggested taking a thirty-minute walk every day.
tip: 絕不可接 suggest someone to V！必須接 V-ing 或 that 子句省略 should。

example: The teacher advised Mark to read English stories aloud.
tip: 動詞為 advise [z]，名詞為 advice [s]（不可數名詞，不可加 -s）。

example: My mother always encourages me to try new things bravely.
tip: 名詞為 encouragement，形容詞為 encouraging。

example: I noticed an old man crossing the busy street slowly.
tip: 感官動詞！看到全過程用原形 V；看到正在進行用 V-ing。

example: Did you hear someone knocking at the front door just now?
tip: 感官動詞後面不可加 to V！注意三態 hear-heard-heard。

collocation: make + 人 + 原形動詞 / adj.
example: The funny movie made everyone burst into laughter.
tip: 使役動詞接原形動詞！若改為被動語態則必須還原 to (be made to V)。

collocation: let + 受詞 + 原形動詞
example: Mom didn't let my little brother play computer games today.
tip: 三態同形 (let-let-let)，受詞後直接接原形動詞。

collocation: have + 人 + 原形動詞 / 物 + p.p.
example: I will have my sister clean the living room before dinner.
tip: 若受詞是物品且被完成，後面用過去分詞 (have my hair cut)。

collocation: help + 人 + (to) + V / help 人 with 事物
example: Jason helped his classmate (to) carry the heavy luggage.
tip: 受詞後面的 to 可省略，常考改寫句型。

collocation: allow + 人 + to V / be allowed to V
example: Students are not allowed to use cellphones during class.
tip: 對比 let (let 人 + V) 與 allow (allow 人 + to V) 互換考題。

collocation: invite + 人 + to 地點 / to V
example: Peggy invited all her good friends to her birthday party.
tip: 名詞為 invitation，口說與寫作常考社交邀約情境。

collocation: warn + 人 + (not) to V / against V-ing
example: The police warned citizens not to walk alone in the dark alley.
tip: 「告誡某人不要做某事」用 warn someone not to V。

collocation: Suddenly, + S + V（第二格轉折神器）
example: Suddenly, a black cat dashed across the busy street.
tip: 三格連環故事第二格最神轉折副詞，後方接過去簡單式。

example: An unexpected rain shower completely ruined our Sunday picnic.
tip: 由 un- + expected 組成，用來形容故事中的突發狀況。

collocation: be crowded with + 人群/車輛
example: The night market was crowded with tourists and food lovers.
tip: 介系詞固定搭配 with，第一格描述公共場所背景必備！

example: We watched an exciting baseball game at the stadium yesterday.
tip: 修飾「事物」用 exciting；修飾「人的感受」用 excited。

example: Hearing the loud thunder, the little girl felt very terrified.
tip: 事物令人害怕用 terrifying，人感到害怕用 terrified。

collocation: feel exhausted after a long day
example: After climbing the mountain for five hours, we were exhausted.
tip: 比 tired 更高級的詞彙，看圖故事結尾高分詞。

example: Mom felt relieved when she saw the lost child safe and sound.
tip: 第三格難關化解後，描述主角心情的加分詞。

collocation: be grateful to 人 for 事物
example: I am deeply grateful to the kind stranger who returned my wallet.
tip: 注意拼字是 g-r-a-t-e-f-u-l（非 greatful），感謝某人用 to。

example: Helping the stray dog was an unforgettable memory for Kevin.
tip: 結尾感嘆句萬用修飾詞：What an unforgettable day!

example: The pizza baked by grandma tasted incredibly delicious.
tip: 連綴動詞 taste/smell 後直接接形容詞 delicious。

example: The clumsy boy tripped over a rock and dropped his lunch box.
tip: 看圖故事摔倒、打破東西情境絕佳性格形容詞。

collocation: It is generous of 人 to V
example: It was very generous of Mr. Lin to donate books to our school.
tip: 形容人的品格，句型用 It is + adj. + OF 人 + to V。

example: The teacher was always patient with slow learners.
tip: 「對某人有耐心」介系詞用 with；反義詞為 impatient。

example: Cindy felt quite nervous before she walked onto the stage.
tip: 「對某事感到緊張」介系詞用 about。

example: Children are always curious about animals and nature.
tip: 「對…感到好奇」介系詞用 about，名詞為 curiosity。

example: She accidentally dropped her smartphone onto the hard ground.
tip: 過去式必須重複 p 加 -ed：dropped。非故意掉落常搭配 accidentally。

collocation: spill hot coffee on the table
example: The waiter slipped and spilled soup on the customer's shirt.
tip: 三態為 spill-spilled-spilled 或 spill-spilt-spilt。

collocation: slip on the wet floor and fall down
example: Be careful not to slip on the wet stairs after the rain.
tip: 重複 p 加 -ed：slipped；常見片語 slip and fall (滑倒)。

example: Seeing the smoke, they rushed out of the building immediately.
tip: 比 run 更具緊張感與速度感的高階敘事動詞。

collocation: rescue 人/動物 from 危險
example: The brave firefighter rescued the little kitten from the tree.
tip: 「從…中拯救」介系詞用 from (come to the rescue)。

example: The whole family went to a restaurant to celebrate dad's promotion.
tip: 第三格結局歡樂聚會必考動詞，名詞為 celebration。

collocation: apologize to 人 for 事物
example: Jack apologized sincerely to his classmate for breaking the ruler.
tip: 道歉對象用 to，犯錯原因用 for，名詞為 apology。

collocation: praise 人 for 良好行為
example: The principal praised Eric for his honesty in front of all students.
tip: 「因某事稱讚某人」介系詞用 for。

example: The owner rewarded the honest boy with five hundred dollars.
tip: 拾金不昧連環圖題型核心動詞，獎勵用 with。

example: With proper rest and medicine, Grandpa recovered quickly from his cold.
tip: 「從疾病中康復」介系詞用 from。

example: The temperature dropped sharply yesterday, so please put on a warm coat.
tip: 覆述常考三音節單字！發音為 /ˈtɛmprətʃɚ/，中間字母 e 不發音。

example: According to the weather forecast, it might rain this afternoon.
tip: 初級朗讀短文第一句常客！過去式通常同形 forecast。

collocation: make an appointment with the doctor
example: I need to make an appointment with the dentist tomorrow morning.
tip: 公事或診所預約用 appointment；朋友休閒聚會用 date 或 plan。

collocation: borrow books from the public library
example: Please keep quiet while studying inside the school library.
tip: 注意第二個 r 音要發出 /ˈlaɪbrɛri/，不要吞掉成 libary。

collocation: on schedule (準時) / tight schedule (緊湊行程)
example: The flight arrived on schedule despite the heavy fog.
tip: 美式發音為 /ˈskɛdʒʊl/，常用片語 ahead of schedule (超前)。

example: All passengers are requested to fasten their seat belts now.
tip: 廣播廣播詞第一句：Attention, passengers please.

collocation: a piece of luggage / carry-on luggage
example: Can you help me put this heavy luggage into the car trunk?
tip: 不可數名詞！不可加 -s，量詞用 a piece of luggage。

example: Remember to buy your train ticket before entering the gate.
tip: 常見搭配：one-way ticket (單程票) 與 round-trip ticket (來回票)。

collocation: stand behind the yellow line on the platform
example: The express train to Taipei will arrive at platform two soon.
tip: 在月台上介系詞用 on the platform。

example: The polite clerk greeted every customer with a warm smile.
tip: 買東西的顧客用 customer；委託律師或專業顧問的人用 client。

example: Keep your receipt if you want to return or exchange the shoes.
tip: 注意！字母 p 不發音，發音為 /rɪˈsit/，聽音覆述超級陷阱！

example: Students can get a ten percent discount with a valid ID card.
tip: 注意中英打折差異：a 20% discount 代表扣除 20%，也就是「打八折」。

collocation: for your convenience (為了您的方便)
example: We installed a water dispenser on every floor for your convenience.
tip: 形容詞為 convenient；生活名詞 convenience store (便利超商)。

example: This delicious soup is made with all-natural fresh ingredients.
tip: 發音注意四音節 /ɪnˈɡridiənt/，初級短文烹飪題型必備。

example: My grandmother taught me her secret recipe for beef noodles.
tip: 發音不是 /rɪˈsaɪp/！正確發音是 /ˈrɛsəpi/，字尾 e 要唸出 [i]。

example: Doing thirty minutes of aerobic exercise helps reduce stress.
tip: 作「體育運動」通常不可數；作「課本習題」時可數 (exercises)。

example: Our school team won first place in the city soccer tournament.
tip: 三音節單字 /ˈtʊrnəmənt/，校園體育朗讀短文常客。

example: The hardworking tennis player finally became the world champion.
tip: 指「人」是 champion；指「冠軍頭銜/錦標賽」是 championship。

example: You need to practice playing the guitar every afternoon.
tip: 動詞後面一定要接 V-ing！諺語：Practice makes perfect (熟能生巧)。

example: Listening to English podcasts daily will improve your listening ability.
tip: 名詞為 improvement；口說第三部分回答自我目標愛用詞。

example: Watching movies with English subtitles helps improve pronunciation.
tip: 注意拼字！動詞是 pronounce (o-u)，名詞是 pronunciation (無 o)。

example: After studying abroad for a year, Sandy can speak French fluently.
tip: 形容詞為 fluent；副詞修飾動詞 speak/read。

example: Please speak clearly into the microphone during the recording test.
tip: 口說測驗考官最愛標準：speak clearly (咬字清晰)。

example: She answered the examiner's question loudly and confidently.
tip: 形容詞 confident；名詞 confidence (have confidence in...)

example: We frequently visit the local library to read magazines on weekends.
tip: 頻率副詞，可用來替換常說的 often，拉高詞彙豐富度。

collocation: It is convenient for me to V
example: Taking the MRT is very convenient because there is no traffic jam.
tip: 口語回答交通、購物萬用理由：It is very convenient.

collocation: be beneficial to one's health / mind
example: Eating more fresh fruits and vegetables is beneficial to our health.
tip: 比 good for 更高級的代換詞！注意介系詞搭配 to。

example: I like studying in my bedroom because the chair is comfortable.
tip: 發音注意吞音：/ˈkʌmftɚbl/（三個音節，不要唸成 com-for-ta-ble）。

example: Preparing for tests can be stressful, so I often listen to music.
tip: 事物有壓力用 stressful；人感到有壓力用 stressed out。

example: Drinking enough water every day is a simple and healthy habit.
tip: 名詞 health，健康諺語：Health is wealth (健康就是財富)。

example: Jogging in the morning makes me feel energetic throughout the day.
tip: 名詞為 energy，口說描述運動好處時的滿分詞彙。

example: Bubble milk tea is extremely popular among young people in Taiwan.
tip: 在…群體中受歡迎用 with 或 among。

example: Modern smartphones make communication much faster and easier.
tip: 反義詞為 ancient (古代的) 或 traditional (傳統的)。

collocation: traditional festivals like Lunar New Year
example: Making mooncakes is a traditional custom during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
tip: 名詞為 tradition，常用於節慶、飲食回答題型。

example: My favorite hobby is playing badminton with my classmates on weekends.
tip: 口說個人問題必考題！複數去 y 加 -ies (hobbies)。

collocation: play a musical instrument like the piano
example: Learning to play a musical instrument requires patience and practice.
tip: 彈奏樂器冠詞一定要加 the (play the piano / play the violin)。

example: There is a beautiful park and a bookstore in my neighborhood.
tip: neighbor 指「鄰居（人）」；neighborhood 指「整個社區/街坊」。

example: Sun Moon Lake is famous for its peaceful lake scenery.
tip: 不可數名詞！不可加 -s，不可說 a scenery。

example: We should reduce plastic waste to keep our environment clean.
tip: 字母 n 容易被忽略：e-n-v-i-r-o-n-m-e-n-t，發音時中音節要唸清楚。

example: True friendship is based on honesty, trust, and mutual understanding.
tip: 結尾 -ship 表示關係或身份（如 relationship, leadership）。

example: People usually wear formal clothes on formal occasions.
tip: 注意拼字：雙 c 單 s (o-c-c-a-s-i-o-n)，介系詞用 on。

example: The Dragon Boat Festival is celebrated with delicious rice dumplings.
tip: festival 多指慶祝型節慶；holiday 指放假日。

example: I strongly recommend this interesting book to all my classmates.
tip: 回答問題「你會推薦什麼…？」句型第一句開頭神器。

collocation: The main reason is that + S + V
example: The main reason why I like English is that it connects me to the world.
tip: 口說 3+2 擴充法第 2 句專用引導句型。

example: Living in Taipei provides great convenience in daily shopping.
tip: 日常回答城市生活優點時的好用名詞。

example: Speaking English allows me to communicate with people from various cultures.
tip: 「與某人溝通」介系詞用 with，名詞為 communication。

example: Doing volunteer work gave me valuable experience in helping others.
tip: 字根 value，結尾 -able，反義詞為 worthless (毫無價值的)。

example: Traveling alone for the first time was an eye-opening experience.
tip: 不可數時指「生活累積的經驗」；可數時指「一次具體經歷」。

example: I hope I will have the opportunity to study in the United States.
tip: 比 chance 更正式、有發展性的機會，口說加分單字。

collocation: listen to soft music to unwind
example: After a stressful week of exams, I usually watch comedies to unwind.
tip: 比 relax 更生動地道的母語休閒動詞，評審一聽亮眼！

example: Reading books across various fields helps broaden our horizons.
tip: 中譯英必考！一定要用複數 horizons，絕不能寫 open eyes！

example: Traveling abroad can broaden our knowledge and enhance adaptability.
tip: 形容詞 broad + -en 轉為及物動詞。

example: Parents should help children cultivate independent thinking skills.
tip: 比 develop 或 build 更加正式高雅的寫作高頻動詞。

example: Through internships, students can acquire hands-on working experience.
tip: 指經過長期努力而「學會或獲得」，不能用 buy 或 get 取代。

collocation: adopt a new approach to solving the problem
example: We should adopt an active approach to dealing with climate change.
tip: 作名詞「方法」時，後面介系詞固定接 to + V-ing/N！

example: We must cherish the limited water resources on Earth before it is too late.
tip: 中譯英常考「珍惜時光、珍惜資源」，比 treasure 更生動。

example: The government launched projects to preserve ancient historical buildings.
tip: 名詞 preservation。中譯英常考「保護傳統文化與古蹟」。

example: Every student must learn to allocate their study time properly.
tip: 名詞 allocation，中級寫作取代 divide 或 distribute 的高分詞。

example: If we ignore environmental protection, we must bear the severe consequence.
tip: 副詞 consequently (因此，結果是) 是 120 字作文高分轉折詞。

example: Regular physical exercise directly contributes to better mental health.
tip: 介系詞 to 必接動名詞 V-ing 或名詞！不可接原形動詞。

collocation: prevent A from V-ing (阻止 A 發生某事)
example: Wearing masks effectively prevented the virus from spreading rapidly.
tip: 句型結構：prevent + 受詞 + from + V-ing。

example: The drought caused severe damage to local agricultural production.
tip: 比 serious 更強烈的修飾詞，修飾疾病、天災、環境污染。

collocation: play a critical role in... / critical thinking
example: Education plays a critical role in fostering social equality.
tip: 片語：play a critical role in (在…扮演關鍵角色)。

example: The Internet has become an indispensable tool in modern education.
tip: 比 necessary 高級很多！介系詞固定搭配 to。

example: Freedom of speech is a fundamental human right in democratic societies.
tip: 副詞 fundamentally (根本上)，修飾動詞與形容詞。

example: With persistent effort, she made substantial progress in writing.
tip: 寫作取代 a lot of 的滿分量化修飾詞。

example: Using flashcards is an efficient way to memorize English vocabulary.
tip: efficient 指「省時省力有高產出」；effective 指「有產生預期效果」。

example: The government must take effective measures to control housing prices.
tip: 常考搭配詞：take effective measures (採取有效措施)。

collocation: keep in contact with 人 ｜ get close to nature
example: We should get close to nature (NOT contact nature) on weekends.
tip: 官方聽診室抓抓抓！「接觸大自然」是 get close to nature，勿寫 contact！

collocation: develop a habit of V-ing (養成…習慣)
example: He developed a habit of taking notes during English lectures.
tip: 習慣要用 develop/cultivate/form a habit，不可用 make a habit！

example: Consumers prefer environmentally friendly products to reduce carbon emission.
tip: 複合形容詞：environmentally friendly (對環境友善的/環保的)。

example: Industrial wastewater causes hazardous chemical pollution in local rivers.
tip: 動詞 pollute；形容詞 polluted；污染名詞為不可數。

example: Recycling helps conserve valuable natural resources for future generations.
tip: 動詞搭配：conserve/cherish natural resources (節約/珍惜自然資源)。

collocation: protect A from B (保護 A 免於 B 之害)
example: Wearing sunscreen protects your delicate skin from harmful ultraviolet rays.
tip: 結構：protect + 受詞 + from + 危險因子。

example: Students are encouraged to actively participate in volunteer activities.
tip: 介系詞必用 in！等同 take part in 或 join in。

example: The task seemed arduous; nevertheless, we accomplished it ahead of time.
tip: 取代 but 的王者轉折副詞，通常以分號加逗號隔開。

collocation: Furthermore, + S + V（第二論點引導詞）
example: Furthermore, adopting this policy will create hundreds of local jobs.
tip: 第一段第二論點開頭詞，同義詞 moreover / in addition。

example: He practiced consistently; consequently, he took first prize in the speech contest.
tip: 比 so 更具正式因果論證力度的副詞。

example: Some people thrive on city hustle, whereas others prefer tranquil countryside.
tip: 對比句型神器！連接兩個完全相反的論點或生活型態。

example: Similarly, learning a language requires constant practice and exposure.
tip: 引出同類型第二例子時的極佳過渡詞。

example: Undoubtedly, health remains the most precious asset in human life.
tip: 句子開頭用來強化論點確定性，同義片語 beyond doubt。

example: From my perspective, experiential learning yields far deeper comprehension.
tip: 中級作文萬用引出個人立場片語：From my perspective。

example: We should consider every aspect of this issue before reaching a decision.
tip: 寫作分析多角度常用：from this aspect (從這個層面來看)。

example: Perseverance is a crucial factor in achieving long-term personal goals.
tip: 搭配形容詞：crucial / key / primary factor。

example: Smartphone addiction has become a widespread phenomenon among adolescents.
tip: 注意單複數：單數 phenomenon，複數 phenomena！

collocation: follow the latest trend / upward trend
example: Remote working has emerged as an inevitable global trend.
tip: 片語：set a trend (引領風潮) ；follow a trend (盲從跟風)。

example: Quality education empowers every young person to unlock their full potential.
tip: 搭配動詞：unlock / realize one's potential (發揮潛能)。

example: Lack of confidence is often the greatest obstacle on the road to success.
tip: 常搭配 overcome an obstacle (克服障礙)。

example: Instead of backing down, she decided to face the formidable challenge bravely.
tip: 形容詞 challenging (具挑戰性的)。

example: With encouragement from peers, he overcame his fear of public speaking.
tip: 三態為 overcome-overcame-overcome。

example: Through close teamwork, they accomplished the arduous assignment successfully.
tip: 名詞 accomplishment (成就，功績)。

example: Setting specific targets motivates us to achieve our aspirations step by step.
tip: 名詞 achievement (sense of achievement 成就感)。

example: Our mentor constantly emphasizes the importance of time management.
tip: 名詞 emphasis (put emphasis on... 著重於)。

collocation: illustrate the point with an example
example: The professor cited real-life statistics to illustrate his compelling thesis.
tip: 第二段舉例神器：To illustrate, take my own experience as an example.

example: The experimental outcomes clearly demonstrate the feasibility of solar power.
tip: 比 show 更具學術論證說服力的高分動詞。

example: In conclusion, the merits of bilingual education significantly outweigh its costs.
tip: 第二段結尾萬用總結片語：In conclusion。

example: To summarize, cultivating resilience remains essential in our fast-paced society.
tip: 名詞 summary (in summary 總而言之)。

example: Small eco-friendly habits can make a significant difference to our planet.
tip: 名詞 significance；片語 make a significant difference。

collocation: It is essential that + S + (should) + 原形動詞
example: It is essential that every citizen should obey traffic regulations.
tip: 形容詞引導虛擬語氣 that 子句省略 should + 原形動詞。

example: Therefore, establishing realistic goals is crucial for ongoing progress.
tip: 正式總結因果關係，取代日常口語的 so。

collocation: from my viewpoint (P - 立場開門見山)
example: From my viewpoint, online learning provides flexible schedules for busy students.
tip: PREP 答題法前 5 秒破題金句：From my viewpoint, I agree that...

example: In my opinion, art and music education are just as important as science.
tip: 注意介系詞搭配 In my opinion（絕非 According to my opinion）！

example: I strongly believe that teenagers should learn budgeting from a young age.
tip: 修飾同意或相信：I strongly agree with this statement.

example: I am fully convinced that perseverance leads to remarkable accomplishments.
tip: 取代 I think 的高分表達：I am convinced that...

collocation: It is definitely worthwhile to V
example: Traveling solo is definitely an enriching adventure worth experiencing.
tip: 口語回答表示毫無疑問：definitely yes!

collocation: The primary reason is that... (R - 核心理由)
example: The primary reason is that extracurricular sports foster team spirit.
tip: PREP 答題法 Reason 句首模板：The primary reason is that...

collocation: It is crucial for us to V
example: It is crucial to maintain open communication within modern families.
tip: 比 important 更有份量與急迫感。

zh: 極其重要的、生死攸關的
example: Adequate sleep is vital to both physical growth and mental concentration.
tip: 同義詞 crucial / indispensable / critical。

collocation: take advantage of (善用) ｜ major advantage
example: The major advantage of electric vehicles is zero greenhouse gas emission.
tip: 片語：take advantage of (善用機會/佔便宜)。

example: One noticeable disadvantage of working from home is the feeling of isolation.
tip: 口說評估利弊題型：weigh the advantages against disadvantages。

collocation: reap the benefit of ｜ benefit from
example: Students benefit immensely from participating in community service projects.
tip: 受惠於用 benefit from；帶來益處用 bring benefits to。

collocation: a major drawback of this proposal
example: The primary drawback of air travel is its heavy carbon footprint.
tip: disadvantage 的地道同義詞，口說展現詞彙多樣性。

example: Artificial intelligence will have a profound impact on future careers.
tip: 名詞搭配：have a positive / profound / negative impact ON。

collocation: exert a positive influence on teenagers
example: Role models exert an uplifting influence on youth moral development.
tip: 片語：have an influence on (對…產生影響)。

example: The coffee shop boasts a cozy atmosphere perfect for studying quietly.
tip: 形容環境氣氛：cozy / lively / friendly atmosphere。

example: Direct social interaction helps children cultivate emotional empathy.
tip: 動詞 interact (interact with peers 與同儕互動)。

example: Effective interpersonal communication eliminates unnecessary misunderstandings.
tip: 可數時指通訊工具/消息；不可數時指溝通交流。

example: Painting provides an outlet for personal creative expression.
tip: 面部表情用 facial expression；言論自由用 freedom of expression。

example: Winning this championship required seamless cooperation among all members.
tip: 動詞 cooperate (cooperate with someone in V-ing)。

example: Group presentations teach students the genuine value of collaborative teamwork.
tip: 不可數名詞，口說探討課外活動好處的王牌詞彙。

example: Raising a pet nurtures empathy and a sense of responsibility in kids.
tip: 片語：a sense of responsibility (責任感) ；take responsibility for (為…負責)。

example: Practicing an instrument diligently instills rigorous self-discipline.
tip: 常用複合名詞 self-discipline (自律)。

example: Living in a university dormitory fosters maturity and personal independence.
tip: 形容詞 independent (be independent of 獨立於…之外)。

collocation: take the initiative to V (主動去做某事)
example: We should take the initiative to help neighbors in times of trouble.
tip: 常用片語：take the initiative (主動採取行動)。

collocation: demonstrate high adaptability in new situations
example: In a rapidly evolving world, adaptability matters as much as talent.
tip: 動詞 adapt (adapt to new environment 適應新環境)。

collocation: In the foreground of the picture, + S + V
example: In the foreground, a young barista is carefully preparing espresso.
tip: 90 秒看圖配速第 15~45 秒引導詞：In the foreground...

collocation: In the background, we can see...
example: In the background, high-rise office buildings stand under clear blue skies.
tip: 90 秒看圖配速第 45~75 秒引導詞：In the background...

collocation: blend harmoniously into the natural surroundings
example: The eco-friendly resort blends seamlessly into its verdant surroundings.
tip: 恆用複數形式 surroundings！

example: Under unforeseen circumstances, the outdoor ceremony had to be postponed.
tip: 片語：under no circumstances (絕不，引導倒裝句)。

example: The host made an enthusiastic gesture welcoming the visiting guests.
tip: 看圖描述人物互動：gesture of friendliness / make a gesture。

collocation: a surprised / joyful expression on one's face
example: Judging from their facial expressions, the audience is deeply moved.
tip: 看圖推論情緒金句：Judging from his expression, he seems...

example: The boy sitting on the bench has a relaxed and leisurely posture.
tip: 描述人物坐姿或站姿：upright posture (挺拔站姿)。

example: An elderly couple is strolling peacefully along the shaded park pathway.
tip: 比 walk 更具休閒詩意的動作動詞，看圖高分詞彙。

example: A crowd of excited tourists gathered around the street performer.
tip: 看圖多人聚集場景必備：gather together / gather around。

example: The students are chatting enthusiastically during the school carnival.
tip: 形容詞 enthusiastic (be enthusiastic about 對…充滿熱情)。

example: Several neighbors are sipping coffee and chatting in a leisurely manner.
tip: 既可當副詞也常作形容詞：in a leisurely manner (以從容悠閒的方式)。

example: The protagonist looks noticeably thrilled after receiving the diploma.
tip: 看圖描述變化與反差副詞：look noticeably excited。

example: They are engaged in a seemingly intense and serious discussion.
tip: 90 秒看圖推論神詞：They are seemingly talking about...

example: Apparently, they have spent months rehearsing for this theatrical show.
tip: 看圖最後 15 秒推論前因後果金牌副詞。

collocation: Evidently, the event was a triumph.
example: Evidently, the festival organizers made meticulous arrangements for safety.
tip: 形容詞 evident，同義詞 obviously / clearly。

collocation: reflect the vibrancy of community life
example: The lively market scene reflects the authentic vibrancy of local culture.
tip: 看圖昇華金句：This photo reflects the importance of family bonding.

example: Their jubilant expressions indicate that they passed the challenging test.
tip: 名詞 indication，比 show 更精準具體。

example: The intertwined hands in the painting represent peace and harmony.
tip: 名詞 representative (代表) / representation (象徵)。

example: The blooming cherry blossoms in the background symbolize new beginnings.
tip: 名詞 symbol (a symbol of hope 希望的象徵)。

example: The contrast between old and modern buildings implies rapid urban transformation.
tip: 注意三態 imply-implied-implied；名詞 implication。

zh: 令人難忘的、值得紀念的
example: The family reunion dinner was a deeply heartwarming and memorable occasion.
tip: 90 秒心得昇華萬用詞：This picture captures a truly memorable moment.

zh: 美得令人窒息的、震撼的
example: Standing atop the observation tower, visitors marveled at the breathtaking view.
tip: 描述自然風景、夕陽、山海美景時的頂級形容詞。

example: The harmonious interaction between humans and animals inspires the viewers.
tip: 名詞 harmony (live in harmony with nature 與自然和諧共處)。

example: The street concert received spontaneous applause from passersby.
tip: 描述笑容、歡呼真情流露：spontaneous smile / laughter。

example: In my view, spending weekends doing volunteer work is deeply meaningful.
tip: 90 秒敘述結尾昇華金句：What a meaningful and unforgettable experience!
